metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
metadata.article_title: Power to impose penalty in certain cases.

article.title: Power to impose penalty in certain cases.
article.content: Where the proper officer is of the view that a person is liable to a penalty and the same is not covered under any proceedings under section 62 or section 63 or section 64 or section 73 or section 74 1[or section 74A] or section 129 or section 130, he may issue an order levying such penalty after giving a reasonable opportunity of being heard to such person.
article.html:
127Power to impose penalty in certain cases.

Section 127 · Chapter XIX · page 100 of the Act

Where the proper officer is of the view that a person is liable to a penalty and the same is not covered under any proceedings under section 62 or section 63 or section 64 or section 73 or section 74 1[or section 74A] or section 129 or section 130, he may issue an order levying such penalty after giving a reasonable opportunity of being heard to such person.

1 Ins. by Act 15 of 2024, s. 145 (w.e.f. 1-11-2024).
